label: SINNOH
arrive: Canalave in the snow. The new warehouse is under the drawbridge, and every time it rises the whole place shakes.
{brought} sets down the bags. "Cold. I like it. Keeps people indoors and not looking out the window."
A poster on the wall: GALACTIC ENERGY FOR A NEW WORLD. Somebody has drawn a moustache on it.

owner.name: Lake walkers
owner.line: A quiet lake that hums at night.

owner.name: The neighbours
owner.line: Four houses and a snowman.

owner.name: Professor Rowan
owner.line: Stern old man. Never locks the back door.

owner.name: The producer
owner.line: Will put anything on the air if it rates.

owner.name: The president
owner.line: Every Trainer has one of his watches.

owner.name: The teacher
owner.line: A blackboard full of type charts.

owner.name: The librarian
owner.line: Three floors of old books. One of them is a map.

owner.name: The sailors
owner.line: Ships to Iron Island twice a day.

owner.name: The Mart clerk
owner.line: Stocks rope and nets for the ships.

owner.name: The foreman
owner.line: Coal and fossils, and a lot of tired miners.

owner.name: The curator
owner.line: Fossil labs in the back. Locked with one key.

owner.name: Hikers
owner.line: Every Trainer walks through here first.

owner.name: The engineer
owner.line: The windmills power half of Sinnoh.

owner.name: The flower sellers
owner.line: Honey and flowers, and Galactic grunts asking about honey.

owner.name: Bug catchers
owner.line: Dark woods and an old mansion.

owner.name: The receptionist
owner.line: A Galactic office pretending to be an office.

owner.name: The bike seller
owner.line: Sells bikes nobody can afford.

owner.name: The pilgrims
owner.line: They come to see the old statue and leave flowers.

owner.name: The judges
owner.line: The biggest stage in Sinnoh.

owner.name: The square keeper
owner.line: Only small Pokémon allowed. No grunts allowed.

owner.name: The old caretaker
owner.line: Lost Tower spirits drift in at night.

owner.name: The store manager
owner.line: The biggest shop in Sinnoh. Galactic HQ is across the street.

owner.name: The floor boss
owner.line: Galactic money goes through these slots.

owner.name: Officer Jenny
owner.line: She watches the Galactic building through binoculars.

owner.name: The marsh guides
owner.line: Mud to your knees, Pokémon from every country.

owner.name: The Mart clerk
owner.line: Sells Safari Balls and mud boots.

owner.name: The resort staff
owner.line: Rich guests, a lake, and a hotel full of keys.

owner.name: The temple keeper
owner.line: Down the stairs, something sleeps.

owner.name: Snow walkers
owner.line: A frozen lake at the top of the world.

owner.name: The ferryman
owner.line: One ferry a day, if the ice lets it.

business.name: Pokétch Company
business.text: Every watch tells you the time, and you where they are: +5% on jobs in Jubilife.

business.name: Jubilife TV
business.text: Your story on the evening news. The Hero sees it.

business.name: Cycle Shop
business.text: Fast bikes: +5% on jobs in Eterna.

writers.name: Mine foreman Dag
writers.quote: {first} worked the coal face eight months. Never complained about the dust.

writers.name: Bike shop owner Rae
writers.quote: {first} fixed bikes with me. Fast hands. Faster legs.

writers.name: Game Corner usher Sid
writers.quote: {first} worked the floor at the Game Corner. Saw the Galactic suits come and go.

writers.name: Great Marsh guide Olu
writers.quote: {first} guided tourists through the marsh. Never lost one in the mud.

writers.name: Contest hall dresser Belle
writers.quote: {first} dressed Pokémon for the Contests. Eye for detail.

writers.name: Library keeper Mott
writers.quote: {first} read every book about the lakes. Every one. Twice.
